entities.name: Whitcombe Family Trust
entities.about: Settled by Joan Whitcombe in 2014. Owns 8 Totara Place, a rental let at $780 a week through Harcourts, and a term deposit. The house was sold to the trust for a loan Joan holds. Income is allocated to Ana and Tom each year.

manualJournals.narration: Beneficiary income allocated by trustees' resolution of 31 March 2026
